name: kml-merge
description: MERGE CONCEPT ... INTO: links are repointed or deduplicated, attributes are filled with the target winning on conflict, `aliases` are unioned with the source name appended, `_merged_from` records provenance, and the source node disappears.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?drug_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Drug"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Pharmaceutical drug concept type" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?symptom_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Symptom"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Medical symptom concept type" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?treats_pred { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "treats"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Treatment relationship" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?headache { {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "severity": "moderate", "duration": "2-4 hours" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?fever { {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "temperature_range": "38-40°C", "common": true } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 0.9 } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?aspirin { {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "molecular_formula": "C9H8O4", "risk_level": 2, "dosage": "325mg" } SET PROPOSITIONS { ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"}) } } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 0.95 }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?dup { {type: "Drug", name: "ASA"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "aliases": ["acetylsalicylic acid"], "origin": "willow bark", "risk_level": 5 } SET PROPOSITIONS { ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) WITH METADATA { "source": "dup_only", "note": "from ASA" } } } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?pain { {type: "Symptom", name: "Toothache"} } PROPOSITION ?p { ({type: "Drug", name: "ASA"}, "treats", ?pain) SET ATTRIBUTES { "evidence": "weak" } } }

cases.name: merging reports repointed, deduplicated and filled counts
cases.command: MERGE CONCEPT ?dup INTO ?canonical WHERE { ?dup {type: "Drug", name: "ASA"} ?canonical {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} }

cases.name: the source node is gone, so replaying the merge reports not found
cases.command: MERGE CONCEPT ?dup INTO ?canonical WHERE { ?dup {type: "Drug", name: "ASA"} ?canonical {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} }

cases.name: the target won on conflict, gained the missing keys and records provenance
the repointed link kept its own attributes
the deduplicated link kept the target's keys and gained the source-only ones
an ambiguous source binding is rejected
merging across differing concept types is rejected
cases.command: MERGE CONCEPT ?dup INTO ?canonical WHERE { ?dup {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"} ?canonical {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} }

cases.name: merging a node into itself is a no-op success
cases.command: MERGE CONCEPT ?dup INTO ?canonical WHERE { ?dup {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} ?canonical {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} }
